description: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/selector-saturation-audit.ts, the `degenerate` verdict (around line 156) is computed as `saturatedFraction >= satThreshold && variance <= varThreshold` — an AND, so it only flags when the selector is BOTH saturated AND low-variance. This misses the core failure it exists to catch: when the sampled arms' posteriors are undifferentiated (variance_of_means at or below varThreshold, i.e. indistinguishable means / distinct_means <= 1) but saturated_fraction is low. In that case Thompson selection is effectively uniform-random yet the audit reports 'healthy'. Change the degeneracy logic so undifferentiated means (variance <= varThreshold past the existing cold-start guard) also flag as degenerate, preserving the cold-start guard (sampled < minSampled) unchanged. Keep the change minimal and confined to this resolver.
